components.description: Open composite field with accessible name and arrow submit.
components.css: .ds-search-row{font-family:var(--vscode-font-family);font-size:var(--vscode-font-size,13px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;min-height:40px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--vscode-input-border,var(--vscode-panel-border));border-radius:7px;background:var(--vscode-input-background);color:var(--vscode-input-placeholderForeground);}.ds-search-row svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;}.ds-search-row input{font:inherit;flex:1;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:8px 0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--vscode-input-foreground);caret-color:var(--vscode-input-foreground);}.ds-search-row input::placeholder{color:var(--vscode-input-placeholderForeground);opacity:1;}.ds-search-row input:focus-visible{outline:none;}.ds-search-row:focus-within{outline:1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder);outline-offset:1px;}.ds-search-row button{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;padding:0;background:transparent;color:var(--vscode-foreground);}.ds-search-row button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--vscode-toolbar-hoverBackground,var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground));}.ds-search-row button:disabled{cursor:wait;opacity:.45;}.ds-search-row button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder);outline-offset:2px;}:host-context(.vscode-high-contrast) .ds-search-row button,:host-context(.vscode-high-contrast-light) .ds-search-row button{border-color:var(--vscode-contrastBorder);}

narrative.overview:
The sidebar combines a compact music player with a flexible lyric reading surface. It inherits VS Code's theme and font, using artwork, outline controls, quiet separators, and a softly highlighted current row to establish track context without competing with the lyrics.

The approved player composition is theme-adaptive: artwork sits beside title and artist, search stays open initially, and available playback controls remain visible. Source selection, playback status, lyric mode, attribution, reconnect, and paused-follow recovery retain their existing roles.
keyCharacteristics: Artwork and capability-aware outline playback controls.
Open search and timestamped lyric rows with source-provided headings.
Flat surfaces, visible focus, and explicit high-contrast states.
Responsive reading space with reachable controls in short viewports.

rules.name: The Host Theme Rule
rules.body: Preserve VS Code theme roles and the derived accent mixtures; high-contrast overrides take precedence over translucent treatments.

dos: Do inherit host theme colors and font family.
Do preserve the artwork, metadata, header actions, transport, open search, lyric region, and footer hierarchy.
Do retain accessible action labels, keyboard focus, text selection, wrapping, and high-contrast outlines.
Do convey the current lyric with row background, semibold weight, and aria-current as well as color.
Do respect reduced motion and pause following during manual reading.
Do show artwork, LIVE, and section headings only when supported by the relevant metadata or lyric source.
donts: Don't add an independent light/dark palette, decorative typeface, or shadows.
Don't restore collapsed-by-default search or an underline-only current lyric.
Don't enable unsupported playback actions or imply that manual timestamped lyrics follow the player.
Don't clip controls or footer content in narrow or short views.
